govdocs-archive_org-pursue-uap-release-0: PURSUE Release 01, dated May 8, 2026, gathers declassified records on unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's current term for UFOs. It is presented as a Department of War release. After decades of denial, American agencies now publish UAP files in planned batches. The release belongs to that new openness, whatever a reader makes of the sightings themselves. Its documents let the public read the official record directly.
